title: Dev-only worktree tab label (Angular)
description: Write the Angular adapter's dev-only worktree tab label (worktree-tab-label.ts) into an app and, when creating the capability (--wireProviders), wire provideWorktreeTabLabel() into its app.config.ts. On a `<slug>.localhost` worktree domain it prefixes the tab title with `[slug]` and tints the favicon; tree-shaken from prod via ngDevMode.

wireProviders.description: Wire the provider into app.config.ts. TRUE ONLY WHEN ENSURING (creating) the capability — app.config.ts is seeded, never owned, so a detect-only sync must not write to it.

workspaceName.description: Override the base-host sentinel. Defaults to the workspace root directory name.
